images.seen: World at end of 1930: Darfur drawn as british-africa inside Anglo-Egyptian Sudan, Kufra and Greenland's interior grey, otherwise plausible.

A british-africa block sits in Darfur (about 1,086 cells) inside the Sudan; Kufra grey; Senussi Cyrenaica hatched; Italian Africa and Italian Libya drawn as nested greens; matches the packet's Darfur/Sarra flags.

Wrong: the old Jiangxi, Hubei and Sichuan-Shaanxi soviets (about 1,100 cells) are still red in 1935, after the Long March began; and a large grey nobody block (Rehe/eastern Inner Mongolia) north of Beijing. Both patched.

Grey block of about 800 cells between Manchukuo and the Republic: Rehe Province and the land around it, which Cliopatria draws as Japan's but the compiled Manchukuo (Chengde circle only) leaves out. Patched.

Right: Poland partitioned between Germany, the General Government (occupied), the Soviet Union with its Byelorussian and Ukrainian constituents; Bohemia-Moravia occupied; Slovakia, Hungary, Lithuania with Vilnius all plausible.

Xinjiang drawn as a Soviet vassal (the compiler corrects Cliopatria, which draws it as the Communist Party); Japan's puppet governments drawn; grey nobody cells in Shanxi and the Rehe block (Shanxi left, Rehe patched).
After the patch: the Communists hold only northern Shaanxi, the Rehe block is Manchukuo's, no grey block north of Beijing.

issues.what: Darfur (about 1,086 cells) and the rest of the Sudan held by british-africa instead of anglo-egyptian-sudan, until the 1934 keyframe snap (1,117 cells). Cause: the anglo-egyptian-sudan_1916 keyframe uses the gazetteer name 'Sarra Triangle', which does not exist, so the 1916-33 keyframe never applies.

Chinese Soviet Republic drawn as the 1932 scattered soviets (about 1,100 cells in Jiangxi, Hubei, Sichuan-Shaanxi, ...) through 1935, although the Jiangxi Soviet was abandoned in October 1934 and Mao reached northern Shaanxi in October 1935. The dossier says the 1932 shape 'holds for 1932-1934 only' but gives no to-year, so it runs to the end of Cliopatria's span (1935) and is added to the 1935 keyframe.

About 800-1,000 cells of Rehe (Jehol) Province and the land around it (eastern Inner Mongolia, northern Hebei) are land nobody holds from 1932: the Republic's 1932 shape leaves them out and Manchukuo's dossier takes only a 160 km circle round Chengde in 1933. In the draft the grey block lasts to 1939 (about 600 cells after Mengjiang). Patched: the Republic keeps it at the end of 1932 and Manchukuo annexes it on 4 March 1933; Mengjiang takes its Chahar part in 1936 (201 cells). The region is Cliopatria's Japanese shape of 1932-35 in Inner Mongolia, Hebei, Beijing and Tianjin less Manchukuo's 1932 shape; the page does not give the province's outline, so the western tip near Duolun (Chahar, about 200 cells) is Manchukuo's in 1933-35 on this reading.

Cliopatria's Canada shape of 1932-48 takes 119 cells of south-western Labrador from the Dominion of Newfoundland (the canada/dominion-of-newfoundland conflict, R2); the Privy Council gave Labrador to Newfoundland in 1927 and nothing on the page puts any of it under Canada before 1949. The override applies to the whole keyframe (1932-48), so the fix also reaches 1940-48 (p1940-p1949).

Canada's 1932 snap turns 908 lake and Arctic cells (Great Lakes, Great Bear, Great Slave, Winnipeg) that the 1931 Statute of Westminster event gave Canada into unowned land, so lakes show grey inside Canada from 1932 (and in the Great Lakes before). Cosmetic: the shape excludes lake cells.

Greenland's interior ice sheet and the north and east coasts (about 7,580 cells) are land nobody holds until 1936, the date of Cliopatria's whole-island shape. The Eastern Greenland Case page records only the Court's award of 'the disputed territory' (5 September 1933) and Denmark's 1919 claim, so no page dates Danish sovereignty over the whole island.

Shanxi after the Japanese occupation: the shanxi-clique_1938 keyframe (south-western corner only) removes 296 cells of the occupied province from the clique and nothing takes them, so about 188-296 cells of Shanxi are land nobody holds in 1938-39 (108 pass to the Republic in 1939), although the dossier's ledger/7 keeps 618 cells of Shanxi under Japanese occupation. A fix needs a page (the dossier cites https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yan_Xishan) that dates whose land occupied Shanxi was; my page budget was used up.

'Sarra Triangle' is not in the gazetteer. It blocks four things: the anglo-egyptian-sudan_1916 keyframe (1916-33), the italian-libya_1932 keyframe (1932-33), anglo-egyptian-sudan ledger/10 and italian-libya ledger/17 (both 1934). The Sarra Triangle page gives no coordinates ('approximately 30,000 square kilometers', 'in the Kufra District'), so I could not write a polygon. In the draft the land is carried by british-africa (280 cells of the Al Kufrah district until 1933) and italian-africa/ledger/41 (1934), so the 1934 transfer is drawn anyway.

Xinjiang drawn as a vassal of the Soviet Union from 1937 (republic-of-china ledger/50, about 5,500 cells), while Cliopatria draws it as the Communist Party's. A dossier decision resting on 'Xinjiang came under virtual Soviet control'; not checked against a page in this run.

Largest size-rule conflicts: anti-kuomintang-coalition / shanxi-clique (1,470 cell-years, 1930; the clique is a member of the coalition in the Central Plains War), provisional-government / shanxi-clique (797, 1937-38), manchukuo / provisional-government (219), the Africa colonial overlaps (british-africa, french-africa, italian-libya, belgian-congo). The smaller state wins each time, which is right on the pages for the Chinese ones; the African ones are boundary noise between colonies.

1939 Poland: nazi-germany_1939 and second-polish-republic_1939 snaps move 371-408 cells in the invasion year; the image shows the partition as the pages describe it (Germany, General Government occupied, Soviet Union with constituents). The skipped commonwealth-of-australia 1936 gain moves no land.

dossier_requests.what: Make shanxi-clique_1938 keep the occupied Japanese-held province (or add an event giving it to the occupier's puppet government) so about 188-296 cells of Shanxi are not unowned in 1938-39.
dossier_requests.why: Ledger/7 keeps 618 cells under Japanese occupation from November 1937, but the keyframe 'south-western corner of Shanxi' removes the rest from the clique and nothing takes it.

dossier_requests.what: The gazetteer needs a region 'Sarra Triangle' (about 30,000 km2, in the Kufra district of south-eastern Libya) so that anglo-egyptian-sudan_1916, italian-libya_1932 and the two 1934 ledger events resolve; or those four specs need a polygon.
dossier_requests.why: Without it anglo-egyptian-sudan_1916 never applies and Darfur stays british-africa 1917-1933; my patch starts the fix only in 1930, so windows p1910-p1919 and p1920-p1929 still carry it.

problems: Two fetches failed (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eastern_Greenland_case and .../Legal_Status_of_Eastern_Greenland, url_not_found); the page that opens is Eastern_Greenland_Case. Counted against my page budget, so 6 pages opened plus 2 failed attempts.

events/0 starts in 1930, my first year; Darfur is still british-africa in the draft of 1917-1929 (p1910-p1919 and p1920-p1929) because anglo-egyptian-sudan_1916 does not resolve ('Sarra Triangle' missing from the gazetteer). Whoever owns those windows should give Darfur to anglo-egyptian-sudan from 1917, or the gazetteer should gain the region.
keyframe_overrides/1 (canada_1932) replaces the whole keyframe and so also acts in 1940-1948 (window p1940-p1949); it only removes the Labrador cells, which are Newfoundland's until 31 March 1949.

keyframe_overrides/0 (communist-party-of-china_1932) gives from 1932 and to 1934 to a keyframe the dossier left open; the dossier text already says it holds 1932-1934 only. If another window's file overrides the same shape_id the first in window order wins.

The trial's comparison with the published draft also shows changes from other windows' patches and dossier edits made since 1 Nov 20:39 (for example estado-novo to portuguese-mozambique 252 cells, belgian-congo to ruanda-urundi 179, italian-libya snaps and a p1920-p1929 ruling on british-africa / senussi-order); these are not mine. My effects on the 1 Jan 1940 anchor: 540 cells nobody to manchukuo (Rehe), 119 canada to dominion-of-newfoundland, 10 canada to nobody (Labrador cells outside the Dominion's own shape).
No hierarchy.csv row looked wrong in this window (shanxi-clique constituent from 1931, georgian-soviet-socialist-republic constituent from 1937, weihaiwei closed 1930).
The 'republic-of-china / tibet' conflict (139 cell-years, 69 cells in Xinjiang) and the 1,000-odd cell-years of british-africa / french-africa border overlaps were not looked at (small).
